title: Recursive Digit Sum
summary: Return the sum of the decimal digits of a nonnegative integer recursively.
statement: Return the sum of the decimal digits of a nonnegative integer recursively. Implement `recursive_digit_sum` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Integer division removes the final digit and modulo reads it.
Use a single-digit base case, then recurse on n//10.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the recursive_digit_sum invariant is complete.
Editorial: Use a single-digit base case, then recurse on n//10. The intended bounds are O(log n) time and O(log n) space.
